title: Review of the hunting ecology claim with the E gate on fresh seeds 61 and 62: every prey body dissolves within 800 t of a fuel cut while the fed twins keep theirs, prey material kept; but E is the prey's and D the predators' (256^2 seed 61: 11 predator vs 2 prey persistent splits)
summary: Metabolism gate (RUBRIC L4c: abrupt removal with the fed twin alongside on >= 2 seeds) with the author's drive.py at 128^2: fork_t 6000 vs fed, seeds 61 and 62, to t=7500. Prey bodies 14 -> 0 by t=6800 and 12 -> 0 by t=6800 after the fuel cut, mean prey material 0.254 -> 0.256 and 0.236 -> 0.225; the fed twins have 19-20 and 9-10 prey over the same interval. labkit at 256^2 (seed 61, defaults, t=12000, --lineage-k 5): prey 57 -> 5 by t=3000 after predators appear, back to 60 at t=5500, then down to 15 as predators peak at 66; predators 11 persistent splits, generation 2, 0 persistent tracks; prey 2 persistent splits. 128^2 seed 61 with its predator-free twin: twin 21 static prey with 10 persistent splits, 0 moving tracks; with predators 12 prey, 2 persistent prey splits.

observations.S: rerun/seed61_256/sheet.png t=0: noise over the whole domain; prey droplets by t=500, predators from noise added at t=2000.
observations.X: rerun/seed61_256/timeseries.png: prey 57 -> 5 (t=2000-3000) when predators appear, recovery to 60 (t=5500) and decline to 15 as predators peak; rerun/twin_seed61_128 (pred_on 0): static emulsion of 21 prey, 0 moving tracks, against 12 prey with predators at 128^2.
observations.D: rerun/seed61_256/metrics.json species.predator: 11 persistent splits, generation 2 (rods and Y-shapes breaking, sheet t=8400-11000); prey only 2 persistent splits, generation 1.
observations.E: efork/fork_s61.json and fork_s62.json vs fed_s61.json and fed_s62.json (fork_t 6000, same seeds): prey 14 -> 8 -> 5 -> 1 -> 0 (t=6000/6200/6300/6500/6800) and 12 -> 6 -> 4 -> 3 -> 0; fed 14 -> 16 -> 16 -> 16 -> 19 and 12 -> 11 -> 11 -> 11 -> 9; mean prey material 0.254 -> 0.256 and 0.236 -> 0.225 (kept). Every prey body dies, not just the population count.

seeds_run.result: E gate pass (14 -> 0 prey after the cut, fed 19); 256^2: predators 11 persistent splits gen 2, prey 2; 128^2: predators 2, prey 2
E gate pass (12 -> 0 prey after the cut, fed 9-10)

controls_run.E: efork/fork_s61, fork_s62 vs efork/fed_s61, fed_s62 (abrupt fuel removal with the fed twin, two seeds)

verdicts.limitation: The capabilities sit in different kinds: E (the dynamical one) is the prey's, while division is the predators' (11 persistent predator splits vs 2 prey on 256^2 seed 61); predator E is by construction (made only from prey material) and predators survive the fuel cut on dissolved prey (2 and 10 left at t=7500). Labkit finds 0 persistent predator tracks (they dim between meals), so I did not support I. The fork runs are 128^2 drive.py counts, not labkit; the twin is 128^2 only.
